description: Get The Standard Reserve (TSR) S-Bills staking terms right now, on Robinhood Chain: the rate per term and its simple APR at the live term length, drift state, principal locked, premium budget and escrow, caps, pause/close flags, and the early-exit fee window. exit.fee_estimates gives the estimated early-exit fee for four deposit sizes, checked against live quotes. S-Bills are fixed-term STANDARD staking: a deposit locks principal for one term at a per-term rate, with the premium escrowed up front. Rates are per term, not annual; check rate_basis and term_seconds before reading a number as an annual figure. The contract has no automatic roll; the owner must call roll after maturity. Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings; divide by 1e18 to get token amounts.
